title: Kissed Fluffy Tunisian Chicken Breasts Tagine
description: A salty, fluffy, and comforting Tunisian dish featuring chicken breasts, lamination-puff, and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, perfect for a cozy dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper
Add the chicken breasts to the bowl and coat evenly with the marinade
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes
While the chicken is baking, prepare the lamination-puff by mixing together flour, water, and a pinch of salt
After the chicken has baked for 25 minutes, brush the lamination-puff mixture evenly over the top of each breast
Return the chicken to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the lamination-puff is golden brown
Remove the chicken from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving
